# Trillion Bank public reference

Last reviewed: 2026-10-16
Canonical website: https://trillion-bank.jp/

## Company

株式会社Trillion Bank is a Tokyo-based technology company. Through AI Crawler Lab, it studies externally verifiable signals around how public Web information is discovered, retrieved and appears in AI answers or citations. AirReach covers site diagnosis, measurement and improvement; Adctor covers research and PoC for AI information-use management. It is not a bank or financial institution.

Official company information: https://trillion-bank.jp/trillionbank/company/

## AI Crawler Lab - research and validation

AI Crawler Lab observes public information structure, requests that identify themselves as crawlers, site responses, and AI-answer mentions and cited URLs under documented conditions. These observations support information-design, measurement and improvement decisions.

Limitations:
- Crawler arrival, AI-answer mentions/citations, and inquiries or revenue are separate observation points. One does not guarantee another.
- Access logs and User-Agent strings alone do not prove the operator's identity, model training use or adoption in an answer.
- The program does not claim to observe every unknown crawler or every external AI action.

Lab page: https://trillion-bank.jp/#ai-crawler-lab

## AirReach Tools - free site diagnosis

AirReach Tools checks the information structure and AI-search readiness of public pages and identifies an initial improvement priority. It does not by itself measure actual citation rates in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude or AI Overviews.

Free diagnosis: https://trillion-bank.jp/airreach/

## AirReach Consulting - current practical product

Status: limited commercial validation / implementation consultation.

AirReach Consulting can store and share the agreed question and measurement conditions, AI answer text, cited URLs, company and competitor mentions, measurement time and history, CSV or dashboard outputs according to the engagement, and analyst review and improvement-priority support.

Operating model:
1. Observe - design questions and store answers, citations and conditions.
2. Diagnose - review competitor-only questions, source patterns and possible information gaps.
3. Act - agree who will update which official or third-party information.
4. Prove - remeasure using the same methodology and record observed changes.

Limitations:
- AirReach Consulting does not guarantee inclusion, ranking, traffic, leads, bookings or revenue.
- AI answers can vary by service, model, date, region, account and context.
- The service does not reproduce every AI surface or infer a model's internal reasoning.
- AI-crawler control, payment and revenue distribution are not AirReach Consulting functions.

Product page: https://trillion-bank.jp/trillionbank/business/hack2/

## Adctor - research and PoC

Adctor explores how content use by AI, RAG, MCP and agents can be connected to resources and rights holders, buyer identity, license terms, credentials, usage events, evidence strength and future billing workflows.

Adctor is not a completed commercial clearing or autonomous payment system. PoC scope is defined case by case. It does not claim to identify all unknown bots or observe all external AI training/citation activity.

Program page: https://trillion-bank.jp/trillionbank/business/pay-per-crawl/

## Editorial principles

- Use current primary sources for external technical claims.
- Separate facts, customer-supplied information, estimates, interpretation and roadmap.
- Show author, reviewer and review dates on authority articles.
- Structured data must match visible content.
- Correct material errors across HTML, metadata and machine-readable files together.
